text: Mosfell is probably best known for the fact that Egil Skallagrimsson lived there in his old age. Egil was one of the most colorful personalities in Icelandic history. Egils Saga says that Egil was originally buried at Tjaldanes in the western end of the Mosfell Valley. Later his bones were moved to the church Hrísbrú. Finally, after the church at Hrísbrú had been taken down, Egils remains were moved once more to the new church at Mosfell. The possibility exists that the archaeologists may unearth the bones of Egil and thereby reveal whether he had Paget's Disease as has previously been suggested (see Stone-Hard Head of Egil).
